mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_sync_log (project_id, sync_status, add_count, update_count, offline_count, fail_msg, operator) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{syncStatus}, COALESCE(#{addCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{updateCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{offlineCount}, 0), #{failMsg}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT sync_id AS syncId, project_id AS projectId, sync_status AS syncStatus, add_count AS addCount, update_count AS updateCount, offline_count AS offlineCount, fail_msg AS failMsg, operator, create_time AS createTime FROM api_sync_log WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY sync_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
